events.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to know the timing and where we’re meeting first.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Gus: Sure thing — we’re meeting at the community shed at 3 PM on Saturday. I’ve got a few tools you can borrow if you need them.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Pia: That works for me, as long as I know which tools you’re bringing and how long we’ll be there.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout—folks really showed up for it.

events.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s been a nice turnout. If anyone needs a tool, I’ve got a few they can borrow.
events.speaker: Gus
